title: Raster River Map: Upstream Area
description: Native-grid raster of Mekong upstream contributing area at river-map cells.
purpose: Show how contributing area varies across the regional river map.
method: Convert m² to km²; mask invalid/non-positive values; YlGnBu palette with full-map logarithmic normalization by default.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Inputs are already tracked; run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh after standard Python setup.

title: Raster River Map: Basin
description: Original positive integer basin ID raster, without renumbering or replacing IDs with display indices.
purpose: Inspect the original basin ID field and distinguish categorical basin identity from precomputed display colors.
method: One discrete bin per original integer ID; repeat tab20 colors; display-only pseudo-log categorical legend expands IDs 1-20 and compresses higher-ID intervals with representative labels; map normalization unchanged; mask missing/non-positive cells. IDs are categorical, not continuous physical quantities.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/basin.nc (basin, lon, lat; unitless positive integer IDs); map/mekong_15min/params.txt.
data_preparation: Tracked NetCDF input is ready. Basin preparation: map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh invokes region_set_map.F90; map/tools/script_bin2nc/s02-convert_netcdf.sh prepares individual NetCDF files. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Raster River Map: Basin Color
description: Precomputed categorical display colors assigned to river basins on the Mekong map.
purpose: Show precomputed basin display indices as a soft background suitable for future overlays while retaining region boundaries.
method: Display bsncol directly with discrete bins for indices 1-10; mix tab10 RGB with 60% opaque white for distinguishable pastel backgrounds; no physical scale or logarithmic normalization.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Tracked input is ready. map/tools/code/region_set_map.F90, invoked by map/tools/script_region/s01-regional_map.sh, derives display colors using basin information and neighboring-color checks. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Raster River Map: Subbasin Color
description: Prepared subcol display-color fill with black original basin-ID boundaries and a gray nextxy_noedge exclusion mask; supporting subbsn/uparea are preparation fields.
purpose: Explain subbasin structure within higher-level basin units and distinguish no-edge masked cells; display colors are not unique IDs or physical quantities.
method: Read one little-endian int32 NX*NY subcol record, x fastest; mask -9999/unassigned zero; categorical indices 1-10; tab10 with 60% opaque white as in f01c; nearest-neighbor raster and present-index colorbar. Black 0.35-point shared cell edges separate different positive original basin IDs. Overlay missing/non-finite nextxy_noedge cells in neutral gray; retain finite terminal codes. No log normalization.
data_source: Existing Git-tracked Mekong 15-minute map and optional analysis/visualization products; no model run, conversion or regeneration required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/subcol-30000.bin (main fill); netcdf/basin.nc (boundary IDs); netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (gray missing-cell mask); params.txt (geometry). Supporting preparation fields subbsn-30000.bin and uparea.bin are not read by f01d.
data_preparation: Sample is ready. map/mekong_15min/script_params/s06-subbasin.sh uses AREA_THRESHOLD_KM2=30000 and map/tools/code/analysis_subbasin.F90; reusable workflow: map/tools/script_params/s06-subbasin.sh. Cut a qualifying link only when current upstream area exceeds threshold and downstream increase exceeds threshold; not a minimum subbasin-size guarantee. Run visualization/river_map/f01-raster_river_map.sh.

title: Line River Map: Connect Type
description: Directed river-network arrows: thicker black local D8 connections and curved orange Flexible Downstream connections.
purpose: Show explicit local and Flexible Downstream connectivity in the CaMa-Flood river network.
method: Every valid one-based nextxy link; black local arrows with 0.010-inch shafts and orange curved flexible arrows with smaller standard heads and rad=0.22; faint logarithmic uparea raster; no extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready; run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. All three panels draw every valid link; axes clip the common 99-109 E, 9-19 N view.

title: Line River Map: Enhance Tickness
description: All-black lines without arrowheads with enhanced thickness based on source-cell upstream drainage area.
purpose: Emphasize large rivers using thickness while retaining small links.
method: Six equal full-map log-area classes; actual shaft widths 0.008-0.032 inches; local links straight and flexible links curved; faint uparea raster; representative area-width legend; no arrowheads on local or flexible links; direction not explicitly marked; no extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready; run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. All three panels draw every valid link; axes clip the common 99-109 E, 9-19 N view.

title: Line River Map: Enhance Color
description: Shade-rainbow upstream-area arrows over subdued dark-gray categorical bsncol context.
purpose: Show source-cell contributing area with foreground color and moderate thickness over basin display context.
method: cmf_colormap shade-rainbow with continuous full-map logarithmic area normalization; six log-area shaft-width classes 0.008-0.022 inches; categorical dark-charcoal bsncol indices 1-10; local straight and flexible curved arrows; no extent filtering.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no station data or simulation output required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea, m2); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty; one-based destination indices); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry). map/mekong_15min/netcdf/bsncol.nc (bsncol, unitless categorical display indices).
data_preparation: Tracked inputs are ready; run visualization/river_map/f02-line_river_map.sh after standard Python setup. All three panels draw every valid link; axes clip the common 99-109 E, 9-19 N view.

title: Vector River Map: Upstream Area
description: Directed main-network links connect each source cell outlet to the outlet of its nextxy downstream cell; source-cell upstream area is encoded by four map-derived quartile colors and widths.
purpose: Show the CaMa-Flood river topology at geographic unit-catchment outlets, distinct from connections drawn at computational grid-cell centers.
method: Interpret nextx/nexty as one-based downstream indices; connect the exact outlon/outlat of source and destination cells with directed straight segments. Convert source uparea from m² to km² for interpretation, then classify log10 area using full-map source-link quartiles. Use the four Tutorial02 Figure 1c colors and widths; no raster background or other overlays.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map NetCDF products; no model output or external dataset required.
required_data: map/mekong_15min/netcdf/nextxy_noedge.nc (nextx, nexty); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/lonlat.nc (outlon, outlat); map/mekong_15min/netcdf/uparea.nc (uparea); map/mekong_15min/params.txt (grid geometry).
data_preparation: All inputs are tracked and ready to use. After standard Python setup, run visualization/river_map/f03-vector_river_map.sh; no separate preparation step is needed.
